programs.title: Redeeming Love
programs.desc: Based on the bestselling novel by Francine Rivers, Redeeming Love is a powerful story of relentless love and perseverance, as a young couple’s relationship clashes with the harsh realities of the California Gold Rush of 1850. It is a life-changing story of the power of unconditional and all-consuming love. Redeeming Love shows there is no brokenness that love can’t heal.

programs.title: The Intolerant Cooks
programs.desc: Karen and Richard catch up with Melissa at CERES Community Environment Park, where they use some of the fresh produce to whip up penne with crispy bacon and pine nuts, a banana, coconut and hemp smoothie, and a lemon and thyme risotto.

programs.title: American Crime
programs.desc: Thirty-six hours have passed and reality is starting to sink in for all sides. Barb and Russ must come face-to-face with the suspects, Carter and Aubry, for the first time at the arraignment hearing. For Aubry and Carter, the hearing is their first opportunity to see one another since being arrested.
